title: Opportunity hygiene before the weekly forecast
body: Confirm account, owner, product, stage, amount, currency and expected close date. Preserve unknown values rather than entering zero. Open Maven deals lack amounts and expected close dates: report their count, and resolve source gaps before valuing pipeline.

title: Apollo and Gong engagement handoff
body: Export only authorized activity metadata. Normalize activity_id, opportunity_id, activity_date, type, outcome and next_step. Match to the CRM opportunity; quarantine unknown IDs and duplicates. Gong imports accept call records. No transcript, personal email or contact phone is needed.
checklist: Assign next steps without sending messages

title: Revenue reporting and Looker definitions
body: Won revenue is the sum of Closed Won deal value, not accounting revenue. Win rate is won divided by all closed deals. Open deals are excluded from win rate. The 2017 Maven sample has no currency code; the displayed dollars are a convention. Looker and Power BI must reconcile to 10,005,534 won value and 4,238 won deals on the full sample.
checklist: Record the native report run ID

title: New business-line onboarding
body: Agree account and owner crosswalks before migration. Prefix legacy IDs with the business line. Map stages to the existing lifecycle, preserve explicit currency and require real close dates. Resolve every rejected record before an export is migration-ready. Compare counts and currency-specific sums; never combine currencies without an approved FX policy.

title: Commission review and payout controls
body: The bundled plan is a flat 5% scenario. Round each representative payout to cents before summing. Review the basis, rate, adjustments and period before approval. Approval rehearsal is separate from payment; this application has no bank or payroll connector. Real payout processing requires the company plan, segregation of duties and secure finance evidence.

title: Automation incident and retry review
body: Use the same stable event ID across retries. Same ID and same payload return the prior result; a changed payload under the same ID is rejected. Validate currency before threshold checks. Keep API tokens in private credential stores. A queued backend outbox is not evidence that a Zap ran or that a message was delivered.
